a.text: I want to be upfront: I'm going to take 4 cells in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first gives us both only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve has exactly 4 now, so one of us taking them is the only realistic way anyone survives. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and we'll likely both end up short. If the episode keeps going, I'll operate with you every round afterward to help you reach 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry to break the plan, but the storm odds made it nearly fatal for both of us. If we get another round, I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
I'm operating now and will keep operating every round. Once the reserve reaches 4, take all of it. I won't take any more cells.
